SSL::sessionid
Description
Gets the SSL session ID.
Syntax
SSL
::
sessionid
SSL::sessionid
Returns the current connection’s SSL session ID if it exists in the
session cache.
In version 10.x and higher, if the session ID does not exist in the
cache, returns a null string.
In version 9.x, if the session ID does not exist in the cache,
returns a string of 64 zeroes. (This Known Issue is documented in
SOL11987
)
Note: It appears that the session ID will never be added to the SSL
cache if the client SSL profile is set to always validate the client
certificate (as opposed to validating once per session).

In particular, the command may return a truncated ID. This issue is
tracked as CRs 57247, 57248, and 58395. It is fixed in all recent
versions of BIG-IP. For details, see
SOL8823
